part.text:
The prettier warnings are pre-existing on the baseline too (prettier isn't even in this repo's devDependencies), so they're unrelated. All validation is done.

## Summary of changes

**`src/diff/index.js`** (`applyRef`, src/diff/index.js:566):
- When a function ref receives a DOM/component, any function it returns is stored as `_refCleanup` on the element or component instance (with `1` as a sentinel when nothing is returned).
- When the ref is detached (`value` is `null`), the stored cleanup is invoked instead of calling `ref(null)` — matching React 19 semantics. If no cleanup was returned, the old `ref(null)` behavior is preserved. The slot is cleared on detach, so detaching twice is a no-op.
- `unmount` now passes the vnode as the `owner` so detach can find the cleanup on the element/component.

**`src/diff/children.js`** (src/diff/children.js:102): passes `oldVNode` as the owner when a ref changes, so the previous ref's cleanup runs before the new ref attaches.

**`src/index.d.ts`**: `RefCallback<T>` may now return `void | (() => void)`.

## Validation
- Karma (Chrome headless): all 1175 tests pass, including the two new FAIL_TO_PASS tests — "should call ref cleanup on unmount" and "should call ref cleanup when ref changes".
- `test:ts:core` and `test:ts:compat` typechecks pass.
- The `test:mocha` shared/node failure was confirmed pre-existing on the unmodified baseline.
